real_peer: make live-peer: real spice-server in QEMU under Podman with an Alpine guest running Xorg and spice-vdagent; covers transport, TLS, clipboard, resize, file transfer and audio; no Ravada portal, no H.264
toolchain: Xcode 27, Apple Swift version 6.4 (swiftlang-6.4.0.34.1 clang-2100.3.34.1), macOS 27.0 (26A428)

environment_defects_fixed: suites ran in parallel against a single-client server
two display heads crashed QEMU 8.2.2 and 10.0.13 (exit 139)

podman lost the race for the ephemeral loopback port it had just been allocated (1 of 3 consecutive runs, in phase 2 right after phase 1 released its own); the peer start is retried with a fresh allocation, up to 5 times
agent_guest.product_defect_pinned: fixed by ADR-0004: the monitors-configuration send window now has a deadline

file_transfer.guest_report: FILE_TRANSFER_RECEIVED with sha256, keyed on modification-time stability
defects_fixed: this repository's ADR-0001 clipboard patch returned early on denied access and skipped the file-transfer and display-configuration drives at the end of the same method
the dependency's transfer drive is not re-entrant: concurrent drives invalidated each other's commit and re-sent one offset for ever
the 16,000-byte default chunk needs 8 agent tokens; QEMU grants 10 and returns 5 at a time, so the second chunk deadlocked at 7 (stall at 32,000 of 64,000 bytes)
file_transfer.note: the one gate failure among those 7 was the podman loopback-port race in phase 2, after the file test had already passed and recorded its digest

found_by_hand_not_by_the_gate: the guest's Xorg had no input driver and no udevd, so it started with zero input devices; the key test reads evdev, one layer below X, and passed throughout. The gate now requires Xorg to have taken at least two input devices
the application's session window painted its control bar over: the backend's presentation layer was 1024x752 inside a 1024x676 view whose parent did not clip
